content:
# Micah 2 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 2:2 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-they-covet fields and-seize-[them], and-houses and-take-[them]; and-they-oppress a-man and-his-house, a-man and-his-inheritance. |
| LOGOS | They covet fields and seize them, and houses, and take them away; they oppress a man and his house, a man and his inheritance. |
| PNEUMA | You want a certain field? You just take it. You see a house you like? You grab it. You cheat a man out of his property, stealing his family's inheritance. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 2:5 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Therefore you-will-have no-one casting the-line by-lot in-the-assembly-of YHWH." |
| LOGOS | Therefore you will have none to cast the line by lot in the assembly of the LORD." |
| PNEUMA | Others will set the boundaries in your place. You will have no voice in the LORD's assembly. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 2:6 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "Do-not-preach!" they-preach. "They-should-not-preach about-these-things; reproaches will-not-depart!" |
| LOGOS | "Do not preach" — thus they preach — "one should not preach of such things; disgrace will not overtake us." |
| PNEUMA | "Don't preach at us!" you say. "Don't preach about such things! Nothing bad is going to happen to us!" |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 2:7 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Should-it-be-said, O-house-of Jacob, "Is-the-Spirit-of YHWH impatient? Are-these His-deeds?" Do-not My-words do-good to-the-one-walking uprightly? |
| LOGOS | Should this be said, O house of Jacob? Has the LORD grown impatient? Are these His deeds? Do not My words do good to him who walks uprightly? |
| PNEUMA | Should you talk that way, people of Israel? Is the LORD's patience really exhausted? Is this really His nature? Don't My words do good to those who live right? |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 2:8 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | But-recently My-people rise-up as-an-enemy; from-the-front-of [the]-garment you-strip the-cloak from-those-passing-by securely, [those]-returning from-war. |
| LOGOS | But lately My people have risen up as an enemy — you strip the rich robe from those who pass by trustingly with no thought of war. |
| PNEUMA | But My own people have turned against Me like an enemy! You strip the coats off the backs of those who trusted you, those minding their own business, veterans returning from battle. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 2:13 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | The-breaker goes-up before-them; they-break-through and-pass the-gate and-go-out through-it; and-their-king passes before-them, and-YHWH at-their-head. |
| LOGOS | He who opens the breach goes up before them; they break through and pass the gate, going out by it. Their king passes on before them, the LORD at their head. |
| PNEUMA | The One who breaks open the way will go up ahead of them. They will break through the gates and march out free. Their King will lead them — the LORD Himself will be at their head! |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---
